about: One entry per Maxio Advanced Billing operation, keyed by the spec's operationId and by nothing else; to start from a call name, search this file for it. 'call' is this SDK's call. 'map' is the operation's block on the SDK map. 'notes' is the operation's section under knowledge/operations/, or null when Maxio has published none: an explicit "no notes", not a gap. In 'map' and 'notes' the part after '#' is the heading of the block or section, in lower case. Paths are relative to the SDK folder.

replayWebhooks.always: Send at most 1000 ids per call. Replay only after `last_sent_at` is well outside the automatic retry intervals.

updateEndpoint.always: Send the complete `webhook_subscriptions` list: read the current one with `ListEndpoints`, then send every event to keep plus the new ones. An event left out is unsubscribed, and an empty list unsubscribes all.

clearSite.always: Call on test sites only. Choose `cleanup_scope`: `customers` keeps the catalog, `all` also removes products. Afterwards poll until clearing finishes before seeding fixtures.

createCustomer.always: If your app has a user id, send it as `reference`, call `ReadCustomerByReference` first and create only on a 404. On the duplicate-reference 422, read the existing customer back (L2).

listCustomers.always: Never take the first result of a `q` search as the customer; use `ReadCustomerByReference` for an exact match. For incremental sync send `date_field` with a start and an end; an unrecognized `date_field` is ignored (R9).

updateCustomer.always: Pass the Maxio customer `id`, not your reference. Never send `entity_identifier_value` without `entity_identifier_kind`. The `vat_eu` and `national_tax` kinds also need `vat_country`; the other kinds do not.

enableBillingPortalForCustomer.always: Pass `auto_invite=1` if the customer should get the invitation email. Never enable twice; re-send the invite with `ResendBillingPortalInvitation`.

readBillingPortalLink.always: Cache the URL and reuse it until `new_link_available_at`; more than 15 requests before then are blocked with 429.

createCoupon.always: Send exactly one of `percentage` or `amount_in_cents`. Never send a past `end_date`. Put `restricted_products` / `restricted_components` beside `coupon`, not inside it, and never with `allow_negative_balance: true`.

findCoupon.always: Pass `product_family_id` unless the coupon is in the default product family.

validateCoupon.always: Pass `product_family_id` unless the coupon is in the default product family (D18).

updateCouponSubcodes.always: Use only to replace every subcode, and send the complete list. To add codes use `CreateCouponSubcodes` (D18).

createMeteredComponent.always: Send `unit_price` in decimal major units, not cents (R4). Send `prices` for any scheme other than `per_unit`, as contiguous, non-overlapping brackets. On new-Catalog sites give taxable components a `tax_code`.

createQuantityBasedComponent.always: Send `recurring: false` only for a one-time charge (inferred; D10). In `stairstep`, send each bracket's `unit_price` as the flat charge for the whole band (D17).

createEventBasedComponent.always: Follow with `ActivateEventBasedComponent` for each subscription that should be billed; events streamed without it produce no charge and no error.

createComponentPricePoint.always: For `per_unit`, send `prices` as one open bracket: `[{"starting_quantity": 1, "unit_price": X}]`. Keep brackets contiguous and non-overlapping. Hybrid pricing also needs `overage_pricing_scheme`, or the overage block is ignored.

updateComponentPricePoint.always: To change `prices`, get the bracket `id`s from `ReadComponentPricePoint`, then update or `_destroy: true` those; a fresh list is added beside the old one. For new customers only, create and promote a new price point (D9).

createCurrencyPrices.always: Send one row per price bracket of the price point (`price_id`) for the currency. `price` is in major units of that currency, like `unit_price`, not cents (R4).

createProduct.always: Set a `handle` (R6). For yearly billing send `interval: 12` with `interval_unit: "month"`. With a trial, set `trial_type` on purpose (L4). On new-Catalog sites never send `auto_create_signup_page`.

updateProduct.always: Treat every call as creating a new price point and making it the product's default; never use it to change a price (D9). The body requires the price and interval fields: send the current values unchanged.

readProductByHandle.always: Pass the bare handle; never a `handle:` prefix in this path.

createProductFamily.always: Set a stable `handle` you will keep (R6). Send `surcharging: false` if the family's products must not carry surcharges.

createProductPricePoint.always: Settle `interval`, the trial fields and `initial_charge_in_cents` now: `UpdateProductPricePoint` takes only `price_in_cents` and `handle`. Promote the price point if new signups should get it (D9).

listProductPricePoints.always: Never take `[0]` as the default; use `filter[type]=default` or the product's `default_product_price_point_id` (R9). Request at most 200 per page (R8).

updateProductPricePoint.always: This reprices every subscription on the price point (inferred). For new customers only, create and promote a new price point instead (D9).

createProductCurrencyPrices.always: Send `price` in major units of the currency, not cents, although the price point itself is in cents (R4). Send a `baseline` row, plus a `trial` and an `initial` row when the price point has a trial or an initial charge.

createPaymentProfile.always: Send `customer_id` and one payment source; with a `chargify_token`, no card or bank numbers (R15). It is not made a default: follow with `ChangeSubscriptionDefaultPaymentProfile` if a subscription should charge it (L6).

updatePaymentProfile.always: To replace a card use `CreatePaymentProfile`, then `ChangeSubscriptionDefaultPaymentProfile` (D6). This call never collects: after fixing a past-due subscriber's card here, collect with `RetrySubscription` (D12).

deleteSubscriptionsPaymentProfile.always: This removes the profile from every subscription the customer has, not only the one in the path. Each one that charged it then needs a new default: set it with `ChangeSubscriptionDefaultPaymentProfile` (D7).

verifyBankAccount.always: Turn off the client's automatic retry for this `PUT`: tries are capped at 10, then verification is blocked until the merchant contacts Maxio. Treat a timeout as an unknown outcome: check `verified` before sending again (R11).

refundInvoice.always: Send `external: true` only to record a refund made elsewhere (D15). Send `void_invoice: true` only with `apply_credit: false` and a full refund. On consolidated invoices send `segment_uids`.

listInvoices.always: Request each nested array you need (`line_items=true`, ...) (R9). Use datetime filters only with `date_field` set to `created_at` or `updated_at`.

recordPaymentForInvoice.always: Choose `type` on purpose: default `external` only records money taken elsewhere; `prepayment`/`service_credit` draw on that balance; `payment` with `payment_profile_id` collects from that profile. Keep `amount` ≤ `due_amount`.

recordPaymentForMultipleInvoices.always: This records an external payment; it charges nothing (inferred). Give each invoice at most its due amount; to leave a prepayment, raise the total `amount` above the sum of `applications`. Never include a consolidated invoice.

voidInvoice.always: Void only `open`, `canceled` or non-consolidated `pending` invoices (D16). No operation reverses a void. Refund a `paid` invoice with `RefundInvoice` instead.

bulkResetSubscriptionComponentsPricePoin.always: This resets every component on the subscription to its current default price point, "even ones that have not been allocated yet". To move only some components use `BulkUpdateSubscriptionComponentsPricePoints`.

allocateComponent.always: `quantity` is the new total, not a change; on prepaid each allocation adds units (D14). Send `upgrade_charge`, `downgrade_credit` and `accrue_charge` in the `allocation` when the money outcome matters: omitted, defaults decide.

allocateComponents.always: Put `upgrade_charge` and `downgrade_credit` inside each allocation: a component default beats the request's top-level values. Send `accrue_charge` at the top level only. Give every allocation a `component_id`.

deletePrepaidUsageAllocation.always: Choose `credit_scheme` by what the customer should get back: `credit` (Maxio's default) leaves a service credit and returns no money, `refund` refunds with a credit note, `none` gives nothing.

createUsage.always: Send a top-level `uniqueness_token`, unchanged when you resend the same report (R12). After an unknown outcome read `ListUsages` before sending again. Keep a negative `quantity` within the current `unit_balance`.

createSubscription.always: Find the customer (`ReadCustomerByReference`) and any plan it holds (L2); name it once (D1). Send `payment_collection_method` (R14), `reference`, a body-root `uniqueness_token` kept on resends (R12). Timeout, 409: unknown (R11).

listSubscriptions.always: Page until a page comes back empty (R8). The `state` filter cannot name `soft_failure`: to list everyone with access, leave it out and classify each row's `state` (R9, R16). Filter `product` by id or exact name, never a handle.

recordEvent.always: Put a `uniqueness_token` inside the event's `chargify` object (64 characters at most), the same on every resend: a duplicate in the stream is ignored silently, never 409. Events bill only after `ActivateEventBasedComponent`.

bulkRecordEvents.always: Send at most 1000 events per call. Give each event its own `chargify.uniqueness_token`, unchanged on a resend: duplicates in a stream are ignored silently, never 409.

retrySubscription.always: Call only on a `past_due` subscription. It takes a payment and cannot carry a `uniqueness_token`: never resend it automatically, allow 120 seconds, and after a timeout read the subscription back (R11).

updateSubscription.always: A product sent here switches the plan now, with no proration; add `product_change_delayed: true` to switch at renewal (D13). With card details this call can take a payment: turn off the client's automatic retry for it (R11).

cancelSubscription.always: To cancel now, send neither `cancel_at_end_of_period` nor `scheduled_cancellation_at` (D11). On prepaid, `refund_prepayment_account_balance` defaults to a refund and needs the Schedule Subscription Cancellation feature.

resumeSubscription.always: Call only when the state is `on_hold`. Check first whether the original renewal date has passed: after it, resuming charges the customer at once (D12).

pauseSubscription.always: Pause only when `current_period_ends_at` is more than 24 hours away. Set any `automatically_resume_at` at least 24 hours ahead; omit it for an open-ended hold. The state becomes `on_hold`, never `paused` (R16).

updateAutomaticSubscriptionResumption.always: Call only while the subscription is `on_hold`. Send `automatically_resume_at` at least 24 hours ahead, or `null` to remove the date and leave the hold open-ended.

reactivateSubscription.always: It can take a payment: turn off the client's automatic retry for it, and settle a timeout by R11. For resume-or-nothing send `resume: {"require_resume": true}`; plain `resume: true` can start a new, charged period (D12).

migrateSubscriptionProduct.always: Send `preserve_period` explicitly: `true` prorates and keeps the billing date; omitted resets the period and charges in full (D13). Preview first (`trialing`: D13). One random `uniqueness_token` per change, never computed (R12).

overrideSubscription.always: Use it only to align fields Maxio manages with your own history. Other fields do not follow (a new `expires_at` leaves the next assessment date), but `current_period_starts_at` sets how mid-period allocations prorate.

initiateDelayedCancellation.always: Never call while `past_due` (D11). Send a body-root `uniqueness_token` (R12); a timeout is unknown (R11). The answer is only a message: confirm with `ReadSubscription` that `cancel_at_end_of_period` is `true`.

createInvoice.always: Decide `status`: send `"draft"` for review; the default `open` issues the invoice now. Make each line item exactly one of `title` + `unit_price`, `product_id` or `component_id`. Keep `issue_date` at today or earlier.

updateInvoice.always: Send `coupons` only to replace every discount on the invoice: the list you send replaces them all, and `[]` removes them. Send each existing line item with its `uid`; a line without `uid` is added as new.

deleteInvoice.always: Delete only an ad hoc `draft` invoice, and only when it should be gone for good: the invoice "is permanently removed". Void an issued invoice with `VoidInvoice` instead.

createPrepayment.always: Choose `method` on purpose: `credit_card_on_file` charges the default card now (D15). `amount` is in major units: the spec's `amount: 100` comes back as `amount_in_cents: 10000`.

signupWithSubscriptionGroup.always: Send one payer source, at most one payment source, `payment_collection_method` by intent (R14), exactly one subscription with `"primary": true`, and a top-level `uniqueness_token`, unchanged when you resend the request (R12).

updateSubscriptionGroupMembers.always: `member_ids` replaces the whole membership: send every subscription that should stay, plus the new ones. An id you leave out is removed from the group, and an empty list removes every member.

cancelSubscriptionsInGroup.always: This cancels every subscription in the group at once. Unbilled metered and prepaid usage is charged only when you send `charge_unbilled_usage: true`: decide it.

initiateDelayedCancellationForGroup.always: Call only when every subscription in the group is on automatic billing and the group is not `past_due`.

reactivateSubscriptionGroup.always: It attempts payment: canceled invoices from the primary's current period are reopened and charged, and a new period adds new charges. Decide `resume` and `resume_members`. After a timeout read the group back first (R11).

findSubscription.always: A 404 is "not there", not proof that a create failed: after a create with an unknown outcome follow R11. That create gets a new `uniqueness_token` only after a corrected 422, or after a 409 once 120 s pass with nothing found.

purgeSubscription.always: Set `ack` to the subscription's customer id. Call on test sites only. Send `cascade[]=customer` or `cascade[]=payment_profile` only to delete those records too.

addSubscriptionToGroup.always: This decides who pays: the subscription joins the target's group and its payer, or a new group with the target customer as payer (`self`: the subscriber). It must share the target's customer record or hierarchy.

applyCouponsToSubscription.always: Send the codes in the request body. Never use the deprecated `code` query parameter: it replaces every coupon already on the subscription (D18).

refundPrepayment.always: `prepayment_id` is the original payment's account transaction id. For a prepayment made through a payment profile send `external` explicitly: `false` refunds to the profile, `true` only records a refund *(inferred)*.

issueInvoice.always: On automatic collection choose `on_failed_payment`. On remittance subscriptions never send `on_failed_payment`. Issue only `draft` or `pending` invoices (D16).

activateSubscription.always: It can take a payment: turn off the client's automatic retry for it (R11). Set `revert_on_failure` explicitly. Only on Relationship Invoicing sites (R3), for an `awaiting_signup` or `trialing` subscription not in a group.

createFeatureTemplate.always: Settle `key` and `kind` before creating: `key` is rejected on every later update, and `kind` once any feature catalog item uses the template.

archiveFeatureTemplate.always: Send `remove_from_catalog=true` only to revoke access for good: it destroys the template's catalog items and their entitlements at once, and `RestoreFeatureTemplate` does not bring them back.

createProductFeature.always: Send `propagate_to_subscriptions: true` if existing subscribers should get the feature before their next subscription change. Send `value` as `"true"` or `"false"` for an access right, the limit itself for a usage limit.

updateProductFeature.always: Send `propagate_to_subscriptions: true` if existing subscribers must get the new value or periodicity. Left out, this call does not update the entitlements they already hold.

removeProductFeature.always: Send `destroy_entitlements=true` only to revoke access for good: it permanently deletes the catalog item and every entitlement it created. Without it the item is archived and subscribers keep their entitlements.

readSubscriptionEntitlements.always: Match on the prefixed key (`feature.<key>`, `usage.<key>`, `service.<key>`), key entries on `periodicity_key`, and grant access only when `enabled` is true.
